fact: The finance ministry's Eurobond ODD allocation and impact report of October 2025 states that 12 new mairies were using the services of the Réseau National de l'Administration in 2024, as a result of the 6.43 million euros it allocates to e-services and the digitalisation of the public administration, out of a 500 million euro state bond of July 2021 that finances projects inscribed in the public investment programme (PIP); it gives no total of mairies on the network.
title: Rapport 2025 Allocation et Impact (Eurobond ODD)
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie et des Finances, République du Bénin
